calls.summary: First follow-up week. Right knee pain 7/10 climbing stairs. Did the exercises three times and skipped two days for work. Mild stiffness after the exercises. Promised to do them every day next week. Reports a bathroom fall three weeks ago, before the plan started.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi Ana, I am your physio's follow-up assistant. I am calling to see how your recovery is going this week.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: How much does it hurt today from one to ten, and when do you feel it most?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: My right knee hurts seven out of ten, especially when I climb stairs.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: How many times did you manage the exercises this week?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: I did them three times, I skipped two days because I had a lot of work. Next week I will do the exercises every day.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Did you have any new discomfort after the exercises?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: After the exercises it stays a little stiff, nothing strange. Is it normal that it clicks when I go down the stairs? And should I be using ice on it?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: And did you have a fall, or anything that scared you?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Three weeks ago I fell in the bathroom, but nothing has happened since I started the plan.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: That is everything for today. I will send the summary to your physio. Take care, we will talk next week.
